# Full Documentation & Rate Matrix — Reverse Sales Tax Calculator
URL: https://salestaxreversecalculator.com
Last Updated: August 2026

## 1. Overview
salestaxreversecalculator.com (PreTaxPrice) provides free, browser-based financial utilities for consumers, small business owners, freelancers, and accountants to calculate original prices before tax (reverse tax calculation).

## 2. Mathematical Principles
When tax is applied:
  Final Price = Subtotal * (1 + Rate / 100)

To calculate in reverse:
  Subtotal = Final Price / (1 + Rate / 100)
  Tax Amount = Final Price - Subtotal

Common subtraction fallacy:
  Subtracting the percentage from the final price (e.g., $107.50 - 7.5% = $99.44) is mathematically incorrect because the tax was assessed on the $100 base, not the $107.50 total. Correct: $107.50 / 1.075 = $100.00.

- Australia: 10% GST
- Netherlands: 21% Standard, 9% Reduced
- Ireland: 23% Standard, 13.5% / 9% Reduced
- Sweden / Norway / Denmark: 25% Standard

## 6. Privacy & Architecture
All calculation algorithms execute purely client-side within the browser via JavaScript/TypeScript. No financial figures, receipts, or data entries are logged or transmitted to any server.
